digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix / GitHub Actions CI workflow
propositions: Coverage instrumentation is redundantly collected on all three Ubuntu cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite identical production source with no version-conditional branches.
Measured coverage tracing cost is 34 wall-seconds per uninstrumented cell, confirming duplicate measurement adds runner occupancy without distinct verdict value.
Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the sole coverage-collection cell while 3.11, 3.12, and macOS retain full test execution without instrumentation.
All four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) must retain both default and integration pytest tiers to preserve behavioral and contractual compatibility coverage.

The workflow contract must enforce that only Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags and all other cells receive neither, using explicit truthy/falsy slots to avoid GitHub Actions empty-string-falsy gotchas.
